description: Mehlan, Felix Christian and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The SIMPACK multi-body configuration represents a medium-speed drivetrain for a 15 MW floating offshore turbine. It includes a four-point main-shaft support and a three-stage planetary gearbox, with component representations for shafts, gears and bearings. Rigid and flexible modelling choices and global rotor/nacelle boundary inputs are described by the source. Related design reports are supporting evidence; their preliminary mass-reduction claims and omitted dynamics are not generalized into verified operating performance. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The source establishes an implemented or evaluated model. Public source-code availability remains unknown unless explicitly identified below. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
